title: How the Atlantis story passed from Solon to Critias

tellings.quote: I believe it was um Solon to Dropus to Critius the Elder to Critius the Younger who then presented the story at the Socratic forum.

plain: Randall Carlson, a researcher of ancient catastrophes, explains on Jesse Michels's podcast how the story of Atlantis, the legendary lost island civilisation, reached the ancient Greek philosopher Plato. He believes it went from Solon, an Athenian lawmaker who heard it in Egypt, to someone he calls Dropus, then to Critias the Elder, then to Critias the Younger, who told it in the circle around the philosopher Socrates. The chain matters to him because it suggests the tale is an old record passed down, not something Plato made up.
